A [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual residing on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mrlsst/Legends|Mrlsst]] was a famed [[Geneticist/Legends|geneticist]] and professor and was the '''mother''' of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Daakman Barrek]]. She discovered that Barrek was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] through a [[Blood/Legends|blood]] screening and contacted the [[Jedi High Council|Jedi Council]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], hoping that her son would find importance serving the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Barrek quickly rose through the ranks of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], eventually achieving the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] after successfully [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] his first [[Daakman Barrek's first Padawan|Padawan]].<ref name="Databank" />

==Behind the scenes==
Daakman Barrek's [[Parent/Legends|mother]] was mentioned in the [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry for Daakman Barrek on [[StarWars.com]], which was published by [[2004]].<ref name="Databank" />
